# netcup_reverse_dns (Data Source)

The reverse DNS entry of an IP address (SCP REST API). `rdns` is null without an entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_reverse_dns" "example" {
  ip = "192.0.2.10"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address.

### Read-Only

- `rdns` (String) Hostname of the entry.
